capabilities: edit AsciiDoc documents in a dedicated editing mode
render AsciiDoc documents in a reading view
switch between view and edit modes with the Toggle reading view hotkey
extras: Warns the plugin is incompatible with the asciidoc-reader and asciidoc-blocks plugins and to disable them if loading fails; global search of AsciiDoc files is unsupported due to Obsidian API limits. Much of the README is developer build/install instructions rather than user documentation.
problem: Obsidian natively renders and edits only Markdown, so AsciiDoc files in a vault cannot be viewed or edited.
summary: AsciiDoc editor and viewer that lets Obsidian open, render, and edit .adoc documents in dedicated view and edit modes.
